strengths.text: Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX/UI work across web and mobile platforms. We want to see your process (research → ideation → testing → iteration), not just final screens.

Tools: Advanced proficiency in Figma (including component libraries, auto layout, variables, and Dev Mode). Experience with prototyping and user testing tools (e.g., Maze, UserTesting, Optimal Workshop).

Research Skills: Demonstrated experience planning and conducting user research, and translating findings into design decisions. We value designers who can run their own research, not just consume research reports.
Accessibility: Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA standards and inclusive design principles, with evidence of applying them in shipped products.
Communication: Ability to articulate design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including at senior leadership level.
Familiarity with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, React) sufficient to collaborate meaningfully with engineers
Experience with data-informed design—using analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics) to validate design hypotheses
Tertiary qualification in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
Plan and conduct qualitative user research (interviews, usability testing, contextual inquiry) to inform design decisions
Synthesise research into personas, journey maps, and actionable insights
Collaborate with the data analytics team to triangulate qualitative findings with quantitative behavioural data (Amplitude, Google Analytics)
Champion the voice of the customer in sprint planning and stakeholder forums
Design end-to-end user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI for web and native mobile (iOS/Android)
Create interactive prototypes for usability testing and stakeholder review
Ensure all designs meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and Suncorp's inclusive design principles
Apply responsive design principles across breakpoints (mobile-first approach)
Partner closely with front-end engineers during build, providing detailed specs and redlines via Figma Dev Mode
Collaborate with Content Designers to ensure copy and UI work seamlessly together
Present design rationale to senior stakeholders (GM level) with clarity and confidence
Mentor junior designers and support the team's inclusive, psychologically safe culture

gaps.text: Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional UX/UI design experience (agency, in-house, or contract). Financial services, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience is highly regarded but not essential.
Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively within Agile squads, including constructive collaboration with product managers, engineers, and content designers.
Experience working with or contributing to a large-scale design system
Build and maintain components within Suncorp's Figma-based design system ('Spark')
Contribute to the evolution of the 'Spark' design system—proposing new patterns, documenting decisions, and retiring deprecated components
Work within a cross-functional Agile squad, participating in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and design reviews
Participate in cross-squad design critiques and knowledge-sharing sessions
Bankruptcy and credit check (standard for financial services roles under APRA prudential standards)
Evidence of right to work in Australia
Two professional referees (at least one must be a direct manager or supervisor from the past 3 years)
